// diagnostic E-APP-PERMISSION-PURPOSE

Jet.AppPermissionPurpose

`{call}` may ask for {permissions}, but the package's `purposes:` doesn't say why.

What

`{call}` may ask for {permissions}, but the package's `purposes:` doesn't say why.

Why

When the app asks for a device permission, the system shows the person why the app wants it, and a phone build writes the same text into its manifest; a permission the app asks for with no purpose has nothing to show. During `jet check`, Jet reports this diagnostic.

Fix

Say why in the package's `purposes:` (for example `{lines}`), or remove the call.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.AppPermissionPurpose: Tests/UI/app_device_bare_import_target.stderr.

Error: Jet.AppPermissionPurpose: `app.take_photo` may ask for the `camera` permission, but the package's `purposes:` doesn't say why.
  --> Tests/UI/app_device_bare_import_target.jet:4:16
    |
  4 | run: fn() { _: take_photo() }
    |                ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: When the app asks for a device permission, the system shows the person why the app wants it, and a phone build writes the same text into its manifest; a permission the app asks for with no purpose has nothing to show. During `jet check`, Jet reports this diagnostic.
 Fix: Say why in the package's `purposes:` (for example `camera: "…"`), or remove the call.
